sheets.prompt: Create a square 3×3 French vocabulary sprite sheet for ages 15–16. Nine separate regular equal square tiles, centered artwork with generous gutters. From left to right, top to bottom, slash marks new row: folded printed newspaper with an illustrated front page (the newspaper alone), camera operator filming a reporter outdoors at a flooded street, commercial product poster with a bottle and a price tag on an advertising board / morning scene with teen at breakfast and sunrise through window, large analog clock showing twelve o’clock straight up and bright noon light, night scene with crescent moon stars and dark sky / three volunteers handing out food to people at a community table, wheelchair user moving up a broad accessible ramp beside stairs, town-hall style public meeting where two speakers exchange views at podiums. Warm editorial game illustration, realistic objects, fine dark outlines, subtle paper grain. No word labels, brand logos or captions. Large objects clear at thumbnail size. Keep each subject inside its own cell. Transparent background around tiles.

inspection: Formation has two wider frames on the last row, numerique combines several objects and uses wider frames on the last row. Only usable subjects are linked in lexique.csv. The crops are defined in lexique.ts. The original generated PNGs remain in the ImageGen output directory. Contextes was center-cropped to remove empty side margins. Contextes and trajets were resized to 900 pixels on the longest side.
